resources.purpose: Reject stale client effects across page instances and authenticated sessions.
resources.retention: Memory only for the page instance; invalidated on hide and discarded on unload or owner change.
resources.deletion: Discarded synchronously with page runtime invalidation; no new persistent copy exists.
resources.export: Not exported because it is transient authorization-control metadata, not a new user fact.
resources.encryption: Uses the existing authenticated session in memory; no additional at-rest representation is created.
resources.minorPolicyRef: No new collection; inherits the existing authenticated-account policy.
resources.backupDisposition: Not backed up; transient page memory only.
resources.legalHoldSemantics: Not applicable to transient control metadata; canonical account facts remain with the existing owner.
resources.correctionSemantics: Session changes invalidate the owner instead of mutating it in place.

resources.purpose: Remember a preference, study constraint or note that the authenticated user explicitly asks Companion to reuse.
resources.source: Direct user entry on the Companion memory management page only.
resources.retention: Retained while the account exists until the user deletes the item or clears all long-term Companion memories.
resources.deletion: A single delete or clear removes the selected rows; account erasure removes every row for the user.
resources.export: Included with stable ID, category, content, source, revision and timestamps in the personal-data export.
resources.encryption: Uses the existing PostgreSQL encrypted storage and transport controls for account-private data.
resources.residency: Same approved application database boundary as the existing Companion account data.
resources.minorPolicyRef: No inference or public sharing; the authenticated account owner explicitly supplies and controls each item.
resources.backupDisposition: Follows the existing encrypted database backup lifecycle and is removed from live data by user deletion or account erasure.
resources.legalHoldSemantics: No product legal hold is introduced by this feature; any overriding statutory hold remains outside this release unit.
resources.correctionSemantics: Exact-state update requires the current revision; deletion is a hard user-visible removal rather than a hidden active copy.

resources.purpose: Record whether the user permits active long-term Companion memories to be injected into answers.
resources.source: Authenticated user toggle on the Companion memory management page.
resources.retention: Retained while the account exists or until account erasure; disabling changes use, not retention of memory items.
resources.deletion: Account erasure removes the setting; absence is interpreted as enabled with no memory items until the user acts.
resources.export: Included in the personal-data export with enabled state and update time.
resources.encryption: Uses the existing PostgreSQL encrypted storage and transport controls for account-private data.
resources.residency: Same approved application database boundary as the existing Companion account data.
resources.minorPolicyRef: No vendor request receives memory items when this setting is disabled.
resources.backupDisposition: Follows the existing encrypted database backup lifecycle.
resources.legalHoldSemantics: No product legal hold is introduced by this preference setting.
resources.correctionSemantics: The authenticated user can set either exact boolean state at any time.

resources.purpose: Keep a small page-context-scoped conversation window so follow-up questions remain understandable.
resources.source: Successful authenticated Companion questions and answers only.
resources.retention: At most four turns per authorized page context, each expiring two hours after creation.
resources.deletion: The user can clear all live turns immediately; expiry cleanup and account erasure also remove them.
resources.export: All still-retained mini-program and iLink short-term turns are included in the personal-data export.
resources.encryption: Uses the existing PostgreSQL encrypted storage and transport controls for account-private data.
resources.residency: Same approved application database boundary as the existing Companion and iLink data.
resources.minorPolicyRef: No automatic durable extraction; expiry and manual clear apply equally to all authenticated accounts.
resources.backupDisposition: Expired or cleared live rows are not restored into the application from backups.
resources.legalHoldSemantics: No product legal hold is introduced for transient conversation context.
resources.correctionSemantics: Turns are not edited; the user clears them and starts a new context.
